title: 43 Ancient Figures from the Caral Civilization Discovered in Peru
description: Peruvian archaeologists found in Peñico an offering of 43 miniatures made of bone and wood that demonstrate the cultural continuity of the oldest civilization in America.

title: Ancient Quasars Shed Light on Early Cosmic Formation
description: Scientists are probing the dawn of the cosmos to uncover clues about the formation of the first galaxies and supermassive black holes. Quasars, powered by supermassive black holes at galactic centers, emit extraordinary brightness that outshines entire galaxies. Researchers have discovered some of the oldest known quasars dating back 13.4 billion years, offering glimpses into the universe's chaotic infancy. These primeval objects are extremely rare and distant, making them challenging to detect from Earth. Space telescopes like Euclid provide a unique view unaffected by Earth's atmosphere, helping astronomers study these elusive cosmic beacons.

title: Ancient Grains, Timeless Curries: Southern Spice, Taj Coromandel Celebrates Forgotten Recipes of the South
description: Southern Spice, the iconic South Indian specialty restaurant at Taj Coromandel, Chennai invites connoisseurs of regional cuisine on a journey into South India’s rich culinary heritage with Forgotten Recipes of the South, a specially curated gastronomic experience. Celebrating recipes that have quietly faded from everyday kitchens, this limited-period culinary chronicle revives heirloom ingredients, time-honoured cooking...

title: These tiny ancient 'hobbits' weren't fearless hunters after all; scientists say they likely survived by eating what Komodo dragons left behind
description: Ancient Flores hominins likely survived by scavenging large reptile leftovers. New research analysed fossilised bones and modern Komodo dragon feeding habits. Evidence shows these hominins consumed meat-poor skeletal remains after predators. Charred bones previously thought to indicate fire use were from later human arrivals. This suggests a more cautious, opportunistic lifestyle for these ancient islanders.

title: 2,000-Year-Old Gold Rings Found In Thailand Reveal Fascinating Link With Ancient India
description: The gold rings were found with human bones during an excavation at the Don Yai Thong archaeological site in Phetchaburi province last week.
